artworks.title: Porch before a Circular Temple
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with classic elements. The image shows a room with high, arched ceilings and various architectural embellishments. There is a large statue at the top of a staircase in the center, under a domed ceiling with square-paneled motifs. Niches on both sides of the room contain additional architectural details and decorations. In the foreground, several small figures appear to be conversing. The structure is upheld by columns, and light creates contrasts between the shaded and illuminated areas, emphasizing the room's depth.

artworks.title: La France Libératrice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with monoprint inking on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a drummer standing on an elevated surface surrounded by figures. The setting includes a crowd of people below and floating figures above holding various items. The scene is framed with detailed etching techniques.

artworks.title: Dames en Manteaux
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The person on the left is a woman facing the viewer, wearing a cap and holding a hand fan. In the center, a man stands confidently with one foot forward, wearing a wig and holding a cane. On the right, a woman is shown from behind, holding a closed fan. Their clothing is detailed and intricate, set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Perruque à Face/Dame en Robe/Manche en Pagode
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The image shows three 18th-century figures in a row. The figure on the left is a man facing forward in a long coat with hands holding the edge. The central figure is a woman facing forward in a voluminous gown. The figure on the right is a man seen from behind with his upper body twisting towards the viewer. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Les Mentes et Redingottes
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an 18th-century style engraving, each with elaborate clothing and accessories. The first person on the left has a hand extended to the side, wearing a tricorne hat with a plume, a coat with wide sleeves and intricate decorations, a knee-length skirt, and stockings. The second person in the center is covered in a voluminous cloak, wearing a bonnet and styled hair. The third person on the right stands with one hand in their coat, wearing a tricorne hat, a knee-length coat, trousers, and stockings. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Jeune Seigneur François/Dame en Mantille
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The image features three full-length figures from an 18th-century illustration. The person on the left, seen from behind, is a woman holding a fan in her right hand and dressed in a voluminous gown with elaborate floral designs and a cape, along with an ornately covered head. The middle figure, a man, stands slightly turned to his left in profile, with his right foot forward, holding a walking stick or sword in his left hand. He wears a decorated coat with a prominent ribbon on the shoulder, knee-length breeches, and adorned shoes, with styled back hair. The person on the right, a woman, faces to the left in profile, wearing a luxurious gown with a fur-lined cape or mantilla, styled-up hair, and holding a muff. The background is plain, emphasizing the details of the clothing.

artworks.title: Veste et Parrement d'Etofe d'Or/Dame en Bagnolette/Perruques à Face
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in 18th-century attire. Two men and one woman stand in full length. The man on the left has his hands on his hips, the woman in the center has folded hands, and the man on the right has hands on hips. They wear detailed clothing with intricate designs and accessories typical of the 18th century.

artworks.title: Les Palatines/Habit Ordinaire/Les Casaquins
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The illustration shows three figures in historical European attire. In the center, a male figure stands with one hand on his hip and the other holding a cane, wearing a buttoned coat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. He wears a tricorn hat and a curly wig. To the left is a female figure in a dress with a large skirt and intricate patterns, styled hair with tight curls and a frilled cap. On the right, another female figure with her back turned wears a striped dress with a layered skirt, detailed textures, and styled hair covered by a cap. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Redingote/Dame en Habit d'Hyver en Manchon/Veste et Parrement d'Etofe d'Or
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The illustration depicts three full-body figures dressed in elaborate, period-specific attire. The first figure on the left is seen from the back, standing and slightly turning to the side. The middle figure is a woman facing slightly to the side, standing with her hands resting inside a voluminous muff. The third figure on the right also stands facing forward with one leg pointed slightly outward. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Habit Unis/Dame en Panier/Habit Ordinaires
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Funds
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals each in historical fashion attire. The first person on the left stands facing the viewer with legs slightly apart and hands positioned in front. They have a long, curly hairstyle reaching their shoulders. Their clothing consists of an ornate coat with large cuffs and decorative elements, knee-length trousers, and stockings. The central figure, a woman, is turned slightly to the side with her head looking over her shoulder towards the viewer. She wears her hair up, adorned with a cap or bonnet, and an elaborate gown with wide panniers. Her left hand rests on her hip while the right appears to hold a floral object. The third figure on the right is seen from the back in a stance with one hand slightly extended. This person sports a hairstyle tied back with a ribbon and wears a coat, knee-length pants, stockings, and is holding a sword at their side. The background is plain, and the bottom of the image includes annotations indicating fashion types for each figure.

artworks.title: Arabe du désert (Desert Arab)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men and a horse in a desert setting. One man is seated on the ground with one leg bent, bearded with curly hair, wearing a headdress and patterned robes. The second man is offering a cup to the seated man, wearing a sleeveless garment and a cap. The horse stands between them, decorated with tasselled tack. A dog is drinking water on the left side of the image. The background features an arid landscape with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Pêcheur en Canot, au bord d'une Rivière (Fisherman in a Boat)
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a peaceful riverside scene with a serene river stretching across the view. The horizon is visible above the center of the composition, where trees and sky meet. Faint silhouettes of cows and a person can be seen in the distance. A large tree trunk is on the left, and a rowboat with a person fishing is on the river. The intricate brushstrokes detail the trees and foliage meticulously. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring black, white, and gray tones. The reflection in the water mirrors the elements of land, tree, and boat.

artworks.title: Old Swede's Church
artworks.medium: etching in black on chine colle
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic stone building surrounded by trees. The trees have an elaborate trunk and branches stretching into the sky. The horizon is hidden by the dense trees and the overcast sky. The building has an arched doorway and a small steeple. The artwork uses a tonal, monochrome palette of sepia tones to create an aged, serene atmosphere. The brushstrokes and cross-hatch shading provide texture to the foliage, trees, and stonework of the building.

artworks.title: Sih-Chidä and Mahchsi-Karehde
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving, etching, aquatint, and mezzotint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side from head to toe. The person on the left is slightly behind the person on the right. Both individuals have long dark hair adorned with feathers and other decorations. Their facial features are depicted with high cheekbones and strong profiles. The person on the left is wearing a tan garment with colorful beadwork and a blue belt, while the person on the right is dressed in a dark brown cloak with decorative trimming and a large jewelry piece around the neck. They both have decorated moccasins, and the person on the right is holding a feather fan. The background features rocky terrain with sparse vegetation, and in the far distance, a small structure or post stands near the horizon under a clear sky with soft clouds.

artworks.title: Elegant Couple Lunching in a Country Cottage
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as a Gift from Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. The drawing depicts a domestic interior with a focus on a group of individuals and various animals in the room. The setting is a room with a high, beamed ceiling, with draped fabric forming a natural backdrop that suggests a sleeping area or enclosed space. In the foreground, a woman stands by a tub set on a tripod, perhaps engaged in domestic work, facing another woman seated on a chair. The seated woman is adorned in elaborate attire with an intricate hairstyle. A third figure, dressed in period clothing, sits nearby on a stool. Small barnyard animals like hens and chicks are scattered on the floor. In the background, another figure lies comfortably on a bed. Shelving on the walls and various household items reinforce the room's utilitarian purpose.

artworks.title: Forest Treetops Struck by Light
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with stumping on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a forested landscape from a slightly elevated angle. Tall trees cover the scene, blending into the sky. The forest creates depth as trees recede into the distance. Brushstrokes are delicate, depicting leaves and branches. The color palette is muted with soft grays and blues, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Close trees have detailed leaves and branches, while those further away are blurred, adding a dreamy quality.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a man holding a sword and another figure in prayer surrounded by intricate designs. The central image shows two figures in elaborate robes; one with a raised arm holding a sword and the other figure kneeling with hands in prayer. The scene is encased within an ornate oval frame decorated with images of livestock and an angel-like figure. The borders of the drawing are embellished with classical elements, including musical instruments, floral motifs, and faces. The composition includes detailed shading and line work in a style reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque artwork. The framing elements are ornamented with swirling forms, symmetrical ornaments, and face-like carvings.

artworks.title: Seaweed Gatherers on the Shore at Redcar, Yorkshire
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of graphite with touches of gouache and scratching out on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The painting depicts a coastal scene with a broad shoreline, a horizon high in the composition, a tranquil sea, distant landmass, soft brushstrokes capturing the seaside's serenity, an understated color palette of earth tones, figures on the beach, and a sky with pale pinks and blues indicating a calm ambiance.

artworks.title: Rangoon: Patent Slip
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside with a low horizon. There is a calm stretch of water extending towards the left. A wooden rowboat is on a muddy shore with planks and logs. The boat is slightly elevated on a ramp or support. Nearby, there are rustic wooden huts on stilts with thatched roofs along the river's edge. In the background, the river curves alongside land with distant trees. The image is in sepia tones, giving it an antique feel. The scene is tranquil with wood and straw textures against the smooth river.

artworks.title: Rangoon: View of the Cantonment
artworks.medium: 2 albumen silver prints mounted on 3 panels
artworks.description: The image displays a panoramic view from an elevated point, overlooking a settlement with multiple thatched-roof buildings and scattered palm trees. The horizon is positioned in the middle, with rooftops and tree tops forming a line. It seems to be a historical photograph with a focus on capturing details with a soft focus. The color palette is in sepia tones, giving an antiqued feel. The terrain slopes gently upwards in the foreground, framing the scene. In the distance, trees and buildings blend with the sky on the horizon.

artworks.title: Rangoon: View near the Lake
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point overlooking a grassy area leading to a distant structure. In the background, there is a stupa-like building surrounded by smaller structures. The image has a grainy, vintage look with a monochromatic sepia color palette. A path cuts through the grass, with bushes on the sides. Trees and architectural structures are visible in the distance against the sky. The sky is textured in the top section of the image.

artworks.title: Rangoon: North Entrance to the Shwe Dagon Pagoda
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tiered structure rising above barricades. The view is from a slightly elevated perspective, looking across grass towards the structure. Tall trees and the architecture, including pagoda-like spires, obscure the horizon. The sky transitions from light to dark, and the image is in black and white. Detailed textures are visible in the woodwork and masonry. Closest to the viewer is a patch of grassland, leading towards the fenced enclosure and the architecture.

artworks.title: Rangoon: Near View of the Shwe Dagon Pagoda
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: This image shows an ancient temple complex surrounded by dense tropical foliage. Conical stupas rise above the landscape, obscuring the horizon with temple structures and trees. The sky fills the upper part of the image, with the tallest stupa reaching towards it. The stupas' intricate details stand out against the organic forms of the trees. The sepia-toned color palette creates a warm, nostalgic atmosphere, emphasizing the age and history of the scene. Light and shadow areas play across the composition. Grass and trees in the foreground provide a lush base, while the towering stupas add a vertical element to the scene.

artworks.title: Rangoon: Mission House at Kemindine
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a traditional thatched-roof building slightly to the right of the center. Tall trees surround the building, creating a natural frame. The grassy terrain leads up to the house, and the sky is featureless. The image is in sepia tones, giving it an antique quality. The scene has a natural texture, showing detailed elements of the grass, trees, and building.
